    The C*-identity inequality on the tracial-ultraproduct quotient (order-free) #

    ‖z‖ * ‖z‖ ≤ ‖star z * z‖ on MatrixSeqQuotient dim ω σ — the hard C*-direction via le_of_tendsto on the approximate-unit hcore inequality. Imports ONLY the carrier (4a, via the limit file): the approximate unit and its order-derived facts (‖1-u‖≤1, star u = u) enter as opaque hypotheses, so this file touches neither the spectral-order instances (4c) nor the quotient NormedRing (4b) — both of which pervasively slow MatrixSeqAlg elaboration. The assembly file supplies the hypotheses and declares the CStarAlgebra instance.

    ‖z‖ * ‖z‖ ≤ ‖star z * z‖
